claim: The General Court assembles every year on the first Wednesday in January
quote: The general court shall assemble every year on the first Wednesday in January

claim: Article LXXII, which had made sessions biennial, was annulled, restoring annual sessions
quote: providing for biennial sessions of the general court and a biennial budget is hereby annulled

claim: A bill not returned by the governor within ten days after presentation becomes law
citation: Mass. Const. pt. 2, c. 1, § 1, art. II, as amended by amend. art. XC, § 1
quote: if any bill or resolve shall not be returned by the governor within ten days after it shall have been presented, the same shall have the force of a law

claim: If the General Court adjourns within ten days after a bill is laid before the governor and so prevents its return, the bill does not become law
citation: Mass. Const. amend. art. I, as replaced by amend. art. XC, § 2
quote: shall adjourn within ten days after the same shall have been laid before the governor for his approbation, and thereby prevent his returning it with his objections

claim: A law takes effect no earlier than 90 days after it becomes law, except emergency laws and laws not subject to referendum
citation: Mass. Const. amend. art. XLVIII, The Referendum, pt. I
quote: No law passed by the general court shall take effect earlier than ninety days after it has become a law, excepting laws declared to be emergency laws

claim: An emergency law takes effect as soon as it has the force of law; a law not subject to referendum takes effect on the thirtieth day unless declared an emergency
quote: otherwise on the thirtieth day next after the earliest day on which it has the force of a law as aforesaid

claim: The biennial state election is the Tuesday after the first Monday in November of even-numbered years
quote: shall be held on the Tuesday next after the first Monday in November in every even-numbered year

claim: State primaries are held on the seventh Tuesday before the biennial state election
quote: State primaries shall be held on the seventh Tuesday preceding biennial state elections

claim: City and town primaries are held on the 28th day before the election
quote: City and town primaries before all city and town elections shall be held on the twenty-eighth day preceding such elections

claim: A town's annual meeting (and with it the town election) is held between February and June unless a special law or charter sets another time
quote: the annual meeting of each town shall be held in February, March, April, May or June

claim: A town may hold its election of officers separately from the business meeting, still between February and June
quote: the election of town officials and other matters to be determined by ballot shall take place in February, March, April, May or June before or after the annual meeting

claim: A town may move its election or meeting to between 1 February and 31 May when it falls within 30 days of the presidential primary
quote: may, by majority vote, establish a date between February first and May thirty-first for holding such preliminary, primary or town election or annual town meeting

claim: Under chapter 43 standard plans, biennial odd-year city elections are held on the day the city already used
quote: regular municipal elections thereafter shall take place in every odd-numbered year on the day fixed as aforesaid

claim: Plan E cities elect on the Tuesday after the first Monday of November in odd-numbered years
quote: shall take place on the Tuesday next following the first Monday of November in every odd numbered year

claim: A city that holds its election annually or in even years holds it on the third Tuesday of December if its law sets an earlier date
quote: the date of such city election shall be said third Tuesday and not such earlier date

claim: The mayor and aldermen or the selectmen may fix the day of preliminary elections or primaries
quote: The mayor and aldermen in cities or selectmen in towns may fix the day of holding preliminary elections or primaries in their cities and towns

claim: A voter enrolled in a party may receive only that party's primary ballot
quote: No voter enrolled under this section or section thirty-seven shall be allowed to receive the ballot of any political party except that in which he is so enrolled

claim: An unenrolled voter chooses a party's ballot at the primary and stays unenrolled
quote: If the voter was unenrolled before selecting a party ballot, he shall continue to be unenrolled

claim: A voter registered in a political designation that is not a party is treated as unenrolled at a primary
quote: shall be considered unenrolled for the purpose of the primary and shall be eligible to receive a ballot of a political party

claim: Enrollment changes do not take effect for a primary in the 20 days before it
quote: no such enrollment, change or cancellation shall take effect for a primary during the twenty days prior to such primary

claim: Party primary candidates for county offices must have been enrolled in the party for the 90 days before the filing deadline
quote: certifying that he has been enrolled as a member of the political party whose nomination he seeks throughout the ninety days prior to the last day herein provided for filing nomination papers

claim: Political party definition: 3% of the statewide vote or 1% of registered voters enrolled
quote: Such parties shall be eligible to conduct primary elections at the next following biennial state election

claim: State-election ballots carry each candidate's party or political designation, and Unenrolled when there is none
quote: Failure to make a political designation shall result in the term

claim: City ballots carry party designations only where the city election is preceded by primaries
quote: To the name of each candidate for a state or city office, except for city elections which are not preceded by primaries, shall be added in the same space his party or political designation

claim: Town ballots carry a political designation only where the town election is preceded by primaries or party caucuses
quote: except for town elections which are not preceded by primaries or political party caucuses, the political designation contained in the certificate of nomination or nomination papers

claim: Nomination papers for city or town offices need not include a party designation
quote: Certificates of nomination and nomination papers for city or town offices need not include a designation of the party which the candidate represents

claim: Where a town has not accepted municipal primaries, parties nominating for town office do so by caucus
quote: political parties which nominate candidates for elective city or town offices shall do so by direct plurality vote in caucuses, except when city or town charters provide otherwise

claim: A town may instead hold a nonparty town caucus, during which no party caucus may nominate for town office
quote: no political or municipal party caucus shall be held therein for the nomination of candidates for town office

claim: Under chapter 43 plan charters, no city primary or caucus is held except under Plan F
quote: No primary or caucus for municipal officers shall be held, except in a city under Plan F

claim: Plan A city ballots carry no party or political designation
quote: No ballot used at any annual, biennial or special city election shall have printed thereon any party or political designation or mark

claim: Plan F nominates mayor and council in party primaries
quote: with the mayor and city councillors to be nominated in party primaries

claim: Plan E (proportional representation) ballots carry no party designation
quote: No official ballot used at any regular municipal election shall have printed thereon any party or political designation or mark

claim: County offices and district attorneys are nominated in party primaries
quote: district attorney, clerk of court, register of probate and insolvency, register of deeds, county commissioner, sheriff, or county treasurer, unless a certificate from the registrars of voters

claim: A state election includes elections for county officers and regional school committee members elected district-wide
quote: shall apply to any election at which a national, state, or county officer or a regional district school committee member elected district-wide is to be chosen by the voters

claim: District-wide regional school committee candidates appear with no political designation
quote: No political or other designation shall appear on the ballot

claim: Charter commission members are elected without party designation
quote: who shall be elected at large without party or political designation

claim: Representative town meeting candidates' papers bear no political designation other than incumbency (standard form)
quote: that he is a candidate for re-election and shall bear no other political designation

claim: The candidate with the most votes wins
quote: the person receiving the highest number of votes for an office shall be deemed and declared to be elected to such office

claim: A city preliminary election sends the top two (or twice the seats) to the final ballot
quote: The two persons receiving at a preliminary election the highest number of votes for nomination for an office shall

claim: No preliminary is held when no more than twice the seats file
quote: not more than twice as many such statements have been filed with the city clerk for an office as are to be elected to such office

claim: Plan E elects council and school committee at large by proportional representation
quote: the members of the city council and the elective members of the school committee to be elected at large by proportional representation

claim: Plan E voters rank candidates with numbers
quote: Put the figure 1 opposite your first choice

claim: Candidates for state-election offices, including county offices, may be nominated by nomination papers
quote: Nominations of candidates for any offices to be filled at a state election may be made by nomination papers

claim: An unenrolled candidate needs a certificate of non-enrollment and must not have been enrolled in a party after the party-candidate enrollment cutoff
quote: certifying that he is not enrolled as a member of any political party

claim: Each signer signs in person as registered and gives their registered address
quote: Every voter signing a nomination paper shall sign in person as registered or substantially as registered

claim: Only signers who are voters in the city or town and in the district count
quote: which are names of voters both in the city or town and in the district for which the nomination is made

claim: A non-party candidate may not use a party name as their political designation
quote: If a candidate is nominated otherwise than by a political party the name of a political party shall not be used in his political designation

claim: Independent cannot be used as a political designation to qualify a party
quote: provided however, that the designation

claim: Middlesex, Hampden, Worcester, Hampshire, Essex and Berkshire county governments are abolished
quote: The government of each of the following counties, in this chapter called an

claim: Berkshire is the last county named in the abolition list
quote: and (e) Berkshire county on July 1, 2000

claim: Abolishing county government does not change county boundaries
quote: Nothing in this chapter shall affect the existing county boundaries

claim: Sheriffs of abolished counties, including Franklin, become state employees but remain elected
quote: the sheriff of an abolished county, including Franklin county

claim: Sheriffs remain elected officials
quote: The sheriff shall remain an elected official under the provisions of section 159 of chapter 54

claim: Registers of deeds of abolished counties remain elected officials
quote: The registers shall remain elected officials retaining local administrative control

claim: Each county except Nantucket and Suffolk elects three county commissioners for four-year terms
quote: Except in Nantucket and Suffolk counties, there shall be elected in each county

claim: In Nantucket the select board, and in Suffolk the Boston, Chelsea, Revere and Winthrop governments, act as county commissioners
quote: In Nantucket county the selectmen of Nantucket, and in Suffolk county the mayor and city council of Boston

claim: No two county commissioners may come from the same city or town
quote: Not more than one of the county commissioners shall be chosen from the same city or town

claim: Sheriffs are elected in each county every sixth year at the state election
quote: and in every sixth year thereafter, a sheriff shall be chosen by the voters in each county

claim: Registers of deeds are elected by registry district every sixth year
quote: a register of deeds shall be chosen by the voters of each district for the registry of deeds, and of each county not divided into districts

claim: Registers of probate are elected in each county every sixth year
quote: and in every sixth year thereafter, a register of probate shall be chosen by the voters of each county

claim: Clerks of courts are elected every sixth year; Suffolk elects several clerks
quote: the clerk of the courts in counties other than Suffolk, and in Suffolk the clerk of the supreme judicial court for that county and the clerks of the superior court

claim: District attorneys are elected by district every fourth year
quote: a district attorney shall be chosen by the voters in each of the districts into which the commonwealth is divided for the administration of the criminal law

claim: County treasurers are elected every sixth year except in Suffolk and Nantucket
quote: a county treasurer shall be chosen by the voters in each county, except Suffolk and Nantucket

claim: The treasurer's office in abolished counties expired
quote: The office of an abolished county's treasurer shall expire on December 31, 2002

claim: Every county except Barnstable may adopt a charter under chapter 34A
quote: Every county, except Barnstable county, shall have the power to adopt a charter

claim: Every city and town may adopt, revise or amend a charter
quote: Any city or town shall have the power to adopt or revise a charter or to amend its existing charter

claim: A town under 12,000 may not adopt city government; under 6,000 may not adopt representative town meeting
quote: No town of fewer than twelve thousand inhabitants shall adopt a city form of government

claim: Home rule does not grant power to regulate elections beyond the charter procedures
quote: the power to (1) regulate elections other than those prescribed by sections three and four

claim: A change to the composition, mode of election or terms of the legislative body, mayor, manager or select board needs a full charter revision
quote: any change in a charter relating in any way to the composition, mode of election or appointment, or terms of office of the legislative body

claim: The General Court acts on a single city or town by special law on that place's petition, or by two-thirds vote on the governor's recommendation
quote: on petition filed or approved by the voters of a city or town, or the mayor and city council, or other legislative body, of a city, or the town meeting of a town

claim: Existing special laws have the force of a charter
quote: All special laws relating to individual cities or towns shall remain in effect and have the force of an existing city or town charter

claim: Special laws for one city or town are deemed to have the force of a charter
quote: Special laws enacted by the general court applicable only to one city or town shall be deemed to have the force of a charter

claim: In statutes, 'town' includes city
quote: when applied to towns or officers or employees thereof, shall include city

claim: Charters may make an office elected or appointed, but select boards, school committees and open town meeting moderators must be elected
quote: in any town having a board of selectmen the members of such board shall always be elected

claim: School committee members must always be elected where a city or town has one
quote: in any city or town having a school committee the members of such committee shall always be elected

claim: Charters may set term of office and mode of selection of local offices
quote: the term of office or mode of selection of local offices

claim: A city or town may change its method of electing officers only through the chapter 43B charter procedure
quote: may change the same in accordance with the procedures for the adoption or amendment of a charter prescribed by this chapter

claim: Towns elect officers at the annual meeting, by ballot, unless law or charter provides otherwise
quote: choose by ballot from its registered voters the following town officers for the following terms of office

claim: Towns elect three or more selectmen for terms of up to three years
quote: Three or more selectmen for the term of not more than three years

claim: Towns elect three or more school committee members for up to three years
quote: Three or more members of the school committee for terms of not more than three years

claim: Other town officers default to appointment by the selectmen
quote: All other town officers shall be appointed by the selectmen unless other provision is made by law or by vote of the town

claim: Multi-member town boards elect about one-third each year
quote: as nearly one-third as may be shall be elected annually

claim: No town officer's term may exceed five years
quote: In no case shall the term of any officer exceed five years

claim: A town may make an elected office appointed by town meeting vote plus a ballot vote, except the select board and school committee
quote: Any office or board, except the board of selectmen and the school committee, elected under the provisions of section 1 may become an appointed position

claim: A town may elect a moderator to preside at town meetings
quote: elect from the registered voters thereof by ballot a moderator to preside at all town or district meetings

claim: Representative town meeting members are elected by precinct for three-year terms (standard form)
quote: elect, for the term of three years, one third of the number of elected town meeting members to which such precinct is entitled

claim: Districts include fire, water, sewer, light and improvement districts
quote: shall mean a fire, water, sewer, water pollution abatement, refuse disposal, light, or improvement district

claim: Chapter 43 offers six standard city plans; Boston cannot adopt them
quote: Any city, except Boston, which shall adopt, in the manner hereinafter prescribed, one of the plans of government provided in this chapter

claim: Plan A: mayor and council elected at large
quote: a city government and legislative body composed of the mayor and a city council, the councillors being elected at large

claim: Plan A and Plan F mayors serve two-year terms by default
quote: He shall hold office for the term of two years from the first Monday of January following his election

claim: Voters in plan or charter cities with a mayor may adopt a four-year mayoral term
quote: Shall the term of office of mayor of the city of ___ be four years?

claim: Cities of 150,000 or more (except Plan E) must have council and school committee seats elected from districts
quote: shall apply to all cities of one hundred and fifty thousand or more inhabitants

claim: A regional school district chooses how its committee is selected: by member town, district-wide at the state election, weighted, or appointed
quote: electing members in district-wide elections to be held at the biennial state elections

claim: Regional committees may instead be appointed by locally elected officials
quote: appointing committee members by locally elected officials such as school board members

claim: District-wide regional school committee terms are set by the district, up to four years
quote: such terms shall not exceed four years

claim: Cambridge elects nine councillors and six school committee members at large by PR for two-year terms; council picks the mayor
quote: nine Councillors and six School Committee members elected at large by Proportional Representation (PR) for a two year term

claim: Cambridge adopted a new charter in 2025
quote: In 2025, the City of Cambridge voted to adopt a new charter

claim: Boston City Council: four at-large and nine district councilors, elected every two years
quote: The council is made up of four at-large councilors that represent the entire City, and nine district councilors

claim: Statute itself calls Agawam a city known as a town
quote: in the city known as the town of Agawam

claim: Plan B: mayor and council elected partly at large and partly by ward
quote: the councillors being elected partly at large and partly from districts or wards of the city

claim: Plan D: council with a mayor among its members, and a city manager
quote: one of whom shall be mayor and shall be the official head of the city, and an administrative officer, called the city manager

claim: Plan E: the council elects the mayor from among its members
quote: one of whom shall be elected as mayor by and from such members

claim: Plan F mayors serve two-year terms by default
quote: He shall hold office for the term of two years from the first Monday in January following his election

claim: Cities and towns may exercise by ordinance or by-law any power not denied by state law or their charter
quote: exercise any power or function which the general court has power to confer upon it

claim: Every city and town may adopt, revise or amend its charter under chapter 43B
quote: Every city and town shall have the power to adopt or revise its charter or to amend its existing charter

claim: Local by-law and ordinance power is restated in chapter 43B
quote: which is not denied, either expressly or by clear implication, to the city or town by its charter

claim: Representative town meeting is limited to towns of at least 6,000
quote: no town of fewer than six thousand inhabitants shall adopt a form of government providing for a town meeting limited to such inhabitants

claim: Cities under the standard plans (other than E and F) hold a preliminary election on the fourth Tuesday before the election
quote: on the fourth Tuesday preceding every regular or special city election
